# TreemapChart

## Overview

Complete treemap chart visualization that orchestrates ChartHeader, ChartLegend, DataDisplay, TreemapGroup (D3 squarify layout), and ChartFooter into a cohesive proportional-area rectangle chart.

**Features:**

- Full chart layout with title, subtitle, legend, optional DataDisplay, and source/notes
- D3-powered treemap layout via TreemapGroup with multiple tiling algorithms
- Categorical colours from `--DataVis-Categorical-Bold-{n}` CSS custom properties — no hard-coded values
- Sequential and diverging colour modes for value-magnitude mapping
- Optional DataDisplay for summary values (static or hover-driven)
- Dynamic segment content visibility — DataHead labels shown only when text fits
- Accessibility support with screen reader summaries via ChartAccessibility

All tokens flow through the Convex → `generateDataVisCSS` → `useStyleInjection` → `@layer brand` pipeline — no JS token resolver.

## Figma Reference

- **Node ID**: `903:129321`
- **Design File**: DataVis-Components
- **Figma URL**: https://www.figma.com/design/uA5ExvS0cNXbDEKzT9Rnrt/DataVis-Components?node-id=903-129321

## Architecture

```
TreemapChart (div[data-name="treemapChart"])
├── ChartHeader (title + subtitle)                       — optional
├── ChartLegend (categorical legend, up to 6 items)      — optional
├── DataDisplay (KPI strip, static or hover mode)        — optional
├── div[data-name="treemapGroupWrapper"] (flex: 1)
│   └── TreemapGroup (fillContainer=true)
│       ├── segments (absolutely-positioned divs)
│       │   └── DataHead (value + label)                 — conditional
│       └── HoverBadge (cursor-following)                — optional
└── ChartFooter (source + notes)                         — optional
```

The `treemapGroupWrapper` grows to fill available height (`flex: 1 0 0`) so the treemap always fills the space between the header/legend/DataDisplay and footer.

## Import

```tsx
import TreemapChart from './components/charts/TreemapChart';
```

## Props

### Layer 2: Parent Props

| Prop                 | Type                                           | Default         | Description                                                                      |
| -------------------- | ---------------------------------------------- | --------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |

| `width`              | `number \| string`                             | `640`           | Container width in px or CSS string (e.g. `"100%"`).                             |
| `height`             | `number \| string`                             | `496`           | Container height in px or CSS string.                                            |
| `chartHeader`        | `boolean`                                      | `true`          | Show ChartHeader.                                                                |
| `chartFooter`        | `boolean`                                      | `true`          | Show ChartFooter.                                                                |

| `dataDisplay`        | `boolean`                                      | `false`         | Show DataDisplay above treemap.                                                  |
| `interactive`        | `boolean`                                      | `true`          | Enable hover/click interactivity on segments.                                    |

## TreemapGroupConfig

| Property              | Type                                                         | Default        | Description                                                       |
| --------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------ | -------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `tileMethod`          | `"squarify" \| "binary" \| "slice" \| "dice" \| "sliceDice"` | `"squarify"`   | D3 tiling algorithm.                                              |
| `sortData`            | `"none" \| "ascending" \| "descending"`                      | `"descending"` | Sort order before layout.                                         |
| `showDataHead`        | `boolean`                                                    | `true`         | Show value + label inside segments (when text fits).              |
| `dataHeadConfig`      | `TreemapDataHeadConfig`                                      | `{}`           | Configuration for DataHead inside segments.                       |
| `hoverBadge`          | `boolean`                                                    | `false`        | Show cursor-following DataBadge on segment hover.                 |
| `formatHoverValue`    | `(value, label?, secondaryValue?) => string`                 | —              | Flat hover badge formatter (simple string).                       |
| `formatHoverBadge`    | `(value, label?, secondaryValue?) => DataBadgeConfig`        | —              | Structured hover badge formatter (full DataBadgeConfig).          |
| `hoverBadgePreset`    | `"chartKeys"`                                                | —              | Preset hover badge layout (ignored when `formatHoverBadge` set). |
| `valueFormat`         | `ValueFormatConfig`                                          | —              | Default value format for DataLead.                                |
| `sequentialSteps`     | `1–9`                                                        | `9`            | Sequential intensity steps (for sequential colour mode).          |
| `divergingSteps`      | `1–5`                                                        | `5`            | Diverging steps per side (for diverging colour mode).             |
| `onSegmentHover`      | `(data: TreemapSegmentHoverData \| null) => void`            | —              | Fired on segment hover state change.                              |
| `onSegmentClick`      | `(data: TreemapSegmentHoverData) => void`                    | —              | Fired on segment click or Enter/Space.                            |
| `hoveredSegmentIndex` | `number \| null`                                             | —              | Controlled hover — pins highlighted segment externally.           |
| `ariaLabel`           | `string`                                                     | —              | Custom aria-label for the treemap group.                          |

## Design Tokens

### Categorical Colours

Segment colours are CSS custom property references resolved at paint time from `@layer brand`:

| Segments | CSS variable                          | Source                                                   |
| -------- | ------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------- |
| 1–6      | `--DataVis-Categorical-Bold-1` … `6`  | Brand-uploaded palette via DataVis pipeline              |
| 7–12     | `--DataVis-Categorical-Bold-{n}/2`    | Monochromatic shade 2 (lighter)                          |
| 13–18    | `--DataVis-Categorical-Bold-{n}/3`    | Monochromatic shade 3                                    |
| 19–24    | `--DataVis-Categorical-Bold-{n}/4`    | Monochromatic shade 4                                    |
| 25–30    | `--DataVis-Categorical-Bold-{n}/5`    | Monochromatic shade 5 (lightest)                         |

**30 distinct colours** before any repetition. Override per-segment with `color` or `colorIndex` in data.

Legend colours use the same CSS var references — they update automatically when the brand or theme changes.

### Layout Token

| Property         | CSS variable                                        | Default           |
| ---------------- | --------------------------------------------------- | ----------------- |
| Section gap      | `var(--TreemapChart-gap, var(--Spacing-5))`         | `--Spacing-5` (~20px) |

## Legend Auto-Generation

When `chartLegend=true` and no `chartLegendConfig.items` is provided:

1. **Categorical mode only**: Legend is auto-generated (sequential/diverging do not auto-generate)
2. Extracts unique categories from data (up to 6 for legend display)
3. Assigns colours from `--DataVis-Categorical-Bold-{n}` tokens, respecting per-datum `colorIndex` or `color`
4. Each legend item gets the indicator `type` from `chartLegendConfig.type` (default: `"circle"`)

---

## Height Behavior

The `height` prop controls the **total chart height**, not just the TreemapGroup. The TreemapGroup automatically stretches to fill the remaining space after header, legend, DataDisplay, and footer are rendered.

```
┌───────────────────────────────────────┐
│  ChartHeader (title + subtitle)       │  ← Auto height
├───────────────────────────────────────┤
│  ChartLegend (optional)               │  ← Auto height
├───────────────────────────────────────┤
│  DataDisplay (optional)               │  ← Auto height
├───────────────────────────────────────┤
│                                       │
│            TreemapGroup               │  ← flex: 1 (fills remaining)
│                                       │
├───────────────────────────────────────┤
│  ChartFooter (source + notes)         │  ← Auto height
└───────────────────────────────────────┘
        Total height: `height` prop
```

## Segment Content Visibility

DataHead content (value + category label) inside each segment is dynamically measured using `measureTextWidth`. If the formatted text does not fit within the segment's available space (width minus padding), it is hidden. Data for hidden segments remains accessible through the HoverBadge tooltip on hover or focus.

---

## Hover Interaction

### Dimming Behaviour

When a segment is hovered:

1. Hovered segment keeps full opacity with the hover colour variant
2. Non-hovered segments fade to `opacity: 0.2`
3. Transition uses hover animation tokens from CSS custom properties

### Color & Opacity States

| State                                  | Color Token                        | Opacity | Description             |
| -------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------- | ------- | ----------------------- |
| **Default** (nothing hovered)          | `--DataVis-Categorical-Bold-{n}`   | `1`     | Original vibrant colors |
| **Highlighted** (this segment hovered) | `--DataVis-Categorical-Hover-{n}`  | `1`     | Hover colour variant    |
| **Dimmed** (another segment hovered)   | `--DataVis-Categorical-Bold-{n}`   | `0.2`   | Reduced opacity         |

## DataDisplay Integration

This chart supports an optional DataDisplay component above the treemap.

### Static Mode (default)

Values come from `dataDisplayConfig` and remain constant:

```tsx
<TreemapChart
  data={data}
  dataDisplay={true}
  dataDisplayConfig={{
    mode: 'static',
    mainLabelValue: 'Total revenue',
    dataHead: { dataLeadValue: '£12.6k' },
  }}
/>
```

### Hover Mode

Values update dynamically when hovering treemap segments:

```tsx
<TreemapChart
  data={data}
  dataDisplay={true}
  dataDisplayConfig={{
    mode: 'hover',
    mainLabelValue: 'Hover a segment',
    formatHoverLeadValue: (value, category) => `£${value.toLocaleString()}`,
    formatHoverBadgeValue: (value, category) => `${((value / total) * 100).toFixed(1)}%`,
  }}
/>
```

## Usage Examples

### Basic Chart

```tsx
<TreemapChart
  data={[
    { id: 'a', category: 'Merchandise', value: 5600 },
    { id: 'b', category: 'Box office', value: 2300 },
    { id: 'c', category: 'TV license', value: 600 },
  ]}
  chartHeaderConfig={{
    chartTitleValue: 'Revenue Breakdown',
    chartSubtitleValue: 'Annual proportions by category',
  }}
/>
```

### With DataDisplay (Hover Mode)

```tsx
<TreemapChart
  data={data}
  width={640}
  height={560}
  dataDisplay={true}
  chartHeaderConfig={{
    chartTitleValue: 'Revenue by Region',
    chartSubtitleValue: 'Hover any segment to update DataDisplay',
  }}
  dataDisplayConfig={{
    mode: 'hover',
    mainLabelValue: 'Hover a segment',
    dataHead: { dataLeadValue: '—', supportingData: false },
    badgeConfig: { value: '—' },
    formatHoverLeadValue: (v) => `€${(v / 1000).toFixed(1)}k`,
    formatHoverBadgeValue: (v) => {
      const total = data.reduce((s, d) => s + d.value, 0);
      return `${((v / total) * 100).toFixed(1)}%`;
    },
  }}
  treemapGroupConfig={{
    tileMethod: 'squarify',
    sortData: 'descending',
    showDataHead: true,
    hoverBadge: true,
  }}
/>
```

### Sequential Colours

```tsx
<TreemapChart
  data={data}
  colorType="sequential"
  sequentialColorSet={2}
  chartLegend={false}
  chartHeaderConfig={{
    chartTitleValue: 'Sequential Colour Mode',
    chartSubtitleValue: 'Higher values get darker colours',
  }}
  treemapGroupConfig={{
    sequentialSteps: 9,
    hoverBadge: false,
  }}
/>
```

### Diverging Colours

```tsx
<TreemapChart
  data={divergingData}
  colorType="diverging"
  chartLegend={false}
  chartHeaderConfig={{
    chartTitleValue: 'Regional Performance',
    chartSubtitleValue: 'Diverging — green for positive, red for negative',
  }}
  treemapGroupConfig={{
    divergingSteps: 5,
    hoverBadge: false,
  }}
/>
```

## Accessibility

`TreemapChart` ships the full reusable ARIA accessibility stack out of the box. The chart-level wrapper is produced by `ChartAccessibility` with `chartType="treemap"`, driven by the `useChartAccessibility` hook, and the inner `TreemapGroup` is automatically opted out of its own wrapper (`accessibility={{ enabled: false }}`) to avoid a nested `role="figure"`.

### Reusable layers

| Layer                                       | Component / Hook                              | Enabled by                | Turn off by                                         |
| ------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------- | ------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------- |
| `role="figure"` + `aria-label`              | `ChartAccessibility`                          | default                   | `accessibility.enabled: false`                      |
| Auto-generated natural-language summary     | `ChartAccessibility` (`chartType="treemap"`)  | default                   | `accessibility.summary: "custom string"` (override) |
| Hidden data table (rows = segments)         | `ChartAccessibility`                          | default                   | `accessibility.dataTable: false`                    |
| Debounced `aria-live` region on hover/focus | `useChartAccessibility` + `useAriaLiveRegion` | default                   | n/a — always on while the chart is interactive      |
| Custom `aria-label` override                | `ChartAccessibility`                          | `accessibility.ariaLabel` | omit the field                                      |
| Roving tab index across segments            | `useRovingTabIndex` (inside `TreemapGroup`)   | `interactive: true`       | `interactive: false`                                |
| `aria-controls` linking Group → DataDisplay | `TreemapChart` wiring (`dataDisplayId`)       | `dataDisplay: true`       | `dataDisplay: false`                                |

### Example screen-reader output

For a categorical treemap titled "Market Share":

> _"treemap chart titled 'Market Share'. Shows 6 data points. Values range from 1,090 to 4,520. Highest value: 4,520 at Germany."_

And when the user hovers or arrow-keys onto a segment:

> _"Germany, 4,520, 28.4% of total"_

### Custom summary and hidden-table control

```tsx
<TreemapChart
  data={data}
  chartHeaderConfig={{ chartTitleValue: 'Market Share' }}
  accessibility={{
    summary: 'Market share by region — Germany still leads but UK is closing the gap.',
    dataTable: false, // suppress the hidden <table> if you don't want SR row navigation
    ariaLabel: 'Market share treemap',
  }}
/>
```

### Fully disable the wrapper

```tsx
<TreemapChart data={data} accessibility={{ enabled: false }} />
// The TreemapGroup's own wrapper is still opt'd out because the Chart always
// passes { enabled: false } downwards — so the tree renders with no role="figure".
```
